title: Government Fund
subtitle: Check whether you can apply for the Spaza Shop Support Fund.
status_green_desc: You could receive up to R300,000 in grants and interest-free loans.
status_amber_desc: Complete the steps below to qualify for up to R300,000 in support.
status_red_title: Let's get the basics sorted first
status_red_desc: You need {count} more registrations before you can apply. We'll guide you.
eligibility_subtitle: These questions decide whether the fund applies to you.
eligibility_sa_citizen_hint: Set during onboarding. Foreign-born owners naturalised as SA citizens before 1994 also qualify.
eligibility_township_rural_label: Shop in township or rural area
eligibility_township_rural_hint: The fund only supports shops in townships or rural areas.
eligibility_owner_managed_hint: The fund requires the owner to run the shop day-to-day.
priority_subtitle: These give you priority consideration during the fund review.
priority_disability_hint: Tell us if you live with a disability — it gives your application priority.
priority_other_groups_note: Youth aged 18–35 and women-owned shops also receive priority. Flag this on your SEDFA application — we don't store this info in Movestock.
eligibility_blocked_warning: The fund requires your shop to be in a township or rural area and owner-managed. You may not qualify.
doc_cipc_conditional_hint: Only required for funding above R80,000 (per the SEDFA / SEFA Spaza Shop Support Programme rules).
doc_sars_grace_hint: You're inside the six-month SARS grace window — SARS isn't blocking your application, but register before the window closes.
compliance_below_floor: The fund expects {min}/100 or higher. Keep your daily checklist up to date.
tier1_stock_desc: For buying initial stock through approved delivery partners.
tier1_infra_desc: For fridges, shelving, security, building upgrades (mix of grant and loan).
tier1_training_desc: POS systems, business skills, digital literacy, food safety.
tier1_cipc_unlock_hint: CIPC registration is required for any funding above R80,000. Register to unlock Tier 2 (up to R300,000).
pack_desc: Movestock will combine your business details, registration status, sales history and compliance records into one PDF.
pack_missing_hint: Complete {count} more documents first. The pack needs all your registrations.
apply_portal_url_hint: spazashopfund.co.za (run by NEF on behalf of SEDFA).
apply_in_person_desc: Visit your nearest SEDFA office. Bring your documents and ID.
